params.body:
When the gateway is out of reach, `hand.mjs` now says so in one line instead of a stack trace.

- `lib/errors.mjs`: `plainError` maps a refused door on `127.0.0.1:8471` to "the gateway did not answer (the tunnel on the box is down); nothing was sent", an unreachable box to its own line, and anything else to its first line. `noReadToken` tells a gh without a token apart from a GitHub answer.
- `hand.mjs`: an `uncaughtException` / `unhandledRejection` handler prints that line and exits 1, so every verb that goes through the door (`propose`, `records`, `agents`, `preview`, `issue`) is covered. Refusals keep their existing output.
- `lib/hand.mjs`: the stale-base check stops with "no read token: the gateway did not answer, so main could not be compared; nothing was sent" instead of counting every file as moved on main.

During the gateway outage of 9 October both cases looked like something else: a crash in `hand.mjs records`, and a propose that would have blamed a moved main.

Tests: `node --test lib/*.test.mjs` 28 of 29; the one failure, in `lib/policy.test.mjs` (`r.json is not a function`), fails the same way on `origin/main`. `node --test voice/*.test.mjs` 26 of 26, `test/agents.test.mjs` 7 of 7. New: `lib/errors.test.mjs`.

The workbench wrappers `~/.local/bin/git-credential-workbench` and `~/.local/bin/gh` are not kept in this repository, so their silent failure is not changed here.
params.title: Say in one line why the way to the gateway failed
